title: Out-of-Network Contractor Reimbursement — Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts
content:
**Rule.** An out-of-network reimbursement under a Homeowner Service Contract is paid only when an assignment recorded as "out-of-network authorized" and a covered determination are both on file for the service request. One out-of-network reimbursement is paid per service request.

**Amount.** The reimbursement is the lowest of:
- the licensed contractor's invoice amount;
- the tier's out-of-network reimbursement cap;
- the remaining item benefit;
- the remaining aggregate benefit.

The service call fee collected on the request is not refunded.

**Not reimbursed.** Work by an unlicensed contractor or by the customer, and work performed before the out-of-network authorization date.

**Worked example (hypothetical inputs).** A Bridgewell HomeCare Silver contract (out-of-network cap 300.00); licensed contractor's invoice 600.00; remaining item benefit 900.00; remaining aggregate benefit 5,000.00. The lowest of 600.00, 300.00, 900.00 and 5,000.00 is 300.00. With a remaining item benefit of 120.00 instead, the reimbursement would be 120.00.

| Records on the request | Reimbursement |
|---|---|
| out-of-network authorization and covered determination | paid, once |
| out-of-network authorization, determination not covered | not paid |
| covered determination, no out-of-network authorization | not paid |
| work dated before the authorization date | not reimbursed |
